source: synthetic weather fixture, not live data
note: SYNTHETIC COMPETITION DEMO FIXTURE -- not Open-Meteo historical data and not a real forecast. Hand-authored TrailGuard replay asset for Phase 5 benchmark scenario B05 (late hazard). The gust ramp is deliberately slow: 21 km/h at 10:00, 24 km/h at 11:00, 28 km/h at 12:00 and only then 50 km/h at 13:00. With the scenario's analysis clock at 10:50 the hiker reaches 13:00 at the +120 horizon and nowhere earlier, so the R-C gust threshold (45 km/h in the frozen rule pack) is crossed by exactly one of the four horizons -- the last one. A run that reports a wind hazard at NOW, +30 or +60 contradicts the core; a run that reports nothing contradicts it at +120. Values are invented. precipitation_probability arrives in percent ('%' in hourly_units, exactly as open-meteo reports it) and must be divided by 100 to obtain the 0..1 probability the TrailGuard schemas use.
